greetingReply: Hi there! I'm the Trend Mart assistant. I can help you with orders, products and sales.
Hello! Welcome to Trend Mart support. Ask me about orders, products or sales.
Hey! Trend Mart assistant here. Need anything on orders, stock or sales?
Hi! Good to see you. I can look up orders, products and sales for you.
helpIntro: I can look things up for you — just ask naturally. For example:
You can ask me things like:
I can check your orders, products and sales. Try asking:
count: It looks like {n} order(s) came in {range}.
orderStatus: "{status}" is where this order stands right now.
orderNotFound: I couldn't find an order with the code {code}. Could you double-check it?
Hmm, no order matches {code}. Mind verifying the code?
Nothing came up for {code}. Let me know if it might be a different code.
todayEmpty: No orders have come in today yet.
It's been quiet today — no orders placed yet.
There are no orders today so far.
Today looks empty so far. Check back later!
customerIntro: Here's what I found for that customer:
customerEmpty: I couldn't find any orders for {who}.
No orders match {who}. Maybe the details differ slightly?
updateDone: All set. {code} is now marked as "{status}".
updateNotFound: I couldn't find an order with the code {code}.
No order matches {code}, so I can't update it.
productCount: There are {n} products in your catalogue.
You have {n} products listed right now.
productEmpty: I couldn't find any products in the "{cat}" category.
productCodeEmpty: I couldn't find a product with the code {code}.
oosIntro: These {n} product(s) are out of stock:
These are the ones running low:
oosEmpty: Great news — nothing is out of stock right now.
No products are out of stock at the moment. Everything's available.
You're all in stock. Nothing to worry about.
